hooks.name: secrets-guard (writes)
hooks.description: Part E and Part A.5: block keys, tokens and .env values in files being written. Use Wrangler secrets and EAS secrets. Runs on Kiro Web.

hooks.name: secrets-guard (shell)
hooks.description: Part E and Part A.5: block shell commands that stage, print or copy secret-bearing files or that carry a token literal.
